speaker: Rina
text: On the road, everyone was looking at the raiders. I looked at the route the villagers could still use.

speaker: Rina
text: Only once the rest of you acted on it. Observations are not rescue missions by themselves.

speaker: Rina
text: Thornrook is for people who keep asking the question after everyone else thinks the matter is settled.
He gestures briefly at the mark above his left brow.

speaker: Rina
text: I have some. More than I should ask a person I met yesterday.

speaker: Rina
text: Come to Thornrook. We can look for answers. And you can tell me when the looking gets in the way of seeing you.
